The Company’s approved medicine, Attruby, is available to people with transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy, and the Company has three additional medicines under FDA review, each for a genetic condition with limited or no approved treatment options: BBP-418 for limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2I/R9, or LGMD2I/R9 (PDUFA date with Priority Review: November 27, 2026); encaleret for autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 1, or ADH1 (PDUFA date with Priority Review: May 7, 2027); and infigratinib for achondroplasia.
